input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The Services clause expressly disclaims any exclusive arrangement and confirms we remain free to offer or sell Inventory through other agents or third parties, which meets the preferred position (no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the Customer). A full-text sweep for "exclusive", "sole", and third-party restriction language found no other provision binding our supply freedom: the remaining "exclusive" references concern a non-exclusive license granted to us, exclusive jurisdiction, each party's own trademark ownership, and the no-third-party-beneficiary clause — none of which restrict our procurement. No redline required.
